'''Prytis''' was the northern continent on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]], known for massive [[Forest/Legends|forests]] and Bakuran nobles' estates. Most Bakurans lived on Prytis and the capital city of [[Salis D'aar/Legends|Salis D'aar]] was located on the continent as well. Prytis possessed an abundance of arable land and extensive agricultural regions, including many [[namana]] plantations in the southernmost regions. Prytis' northern mountain ranges were riddled with mines and quarries.
